notes.title: Minor technical update
notes.content:
A new build for modern times. There are no changes to gameplay, achievements, or leaderboards. Rather, this is simply an updated build, re-compiled and re-built to (hopefully) be more compatible with newer operating systems.

The one downside is that it will no longer work on 32-bit Mac systems. Hopefully that will be balanced by better compatibility with Catalina and beyond (Big Sur, etc.).

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Sprout is a casual, sun-filled, puzzle-adventure from Jeff Nusz and Mindful Mammoth. Originally developed in Flash and published on the web, Sprout was threatened with oblivion by the upcoming end of Flash. Horrors!

Being lovers of puzzles, plants, and adventure, Mindful Mammoth volunteered to rebuild the game in Unity, and give it a new lease on life for a new generation of players. And here it is!
